tasks.prompt: You get every logged negotiation of practice case P01 (ours oldest first, then the EHL 2026 winners' probes) in the attached digest, plus the shared context (rules, what we know, the winners' learnings, our policy.py and writer prompt). Task: (1) Reconstruct this supplier's response behaviour precisely: first counter as a function of our first message (anchor, sheets, claims), per-round steps, what triggers 'agreed'/'final_offer', which levers it values, what it says it wants. (2) Identify the best deal ever reached in the logs and exactly what led to it. (3) Explain where our CURRENT agent (latest sessions) leaves value vs. the best and vs. the record in NIGHT_CONTEXT. (4) Propose 1-3 concrete changes, GENERAL (keyed to supplier archetype / case type / observable signals, never to case or supplier ids), each as a minimal unified diff against src/buyer/policy/policy.py or src/buyer/llm/prompts/writer_system.md, with the expected effect on this case and the risk to other cases. Be skeptical: separate evidence from inference; note run-to-run noise. Keep your written answer under about 3,500 words: findings first, ranked, then diffs.
